title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: Auditor (all genders) at AI Audit-Tech Startup
description:
You won't audit, you'll build what auditors use. We're looking for an experienced auditor who wants to switch sides: instead of working through audits, you'll shape the product that solves the real problems of the audit industry - with a real say in what we build next. Join an ambitious, international team and actively shape the future of dnl as well as the profession.

About dnl

dnl is a fast-growing AI startup building AI-first solutions for auditing. Our software automates disclosure checklists and other document-heavy audit work for audit firms and corporate clients, so professionals can spend their time on judgment instead of manual checking. Our mission: transform auditing through AI and help auditors work smarter than ever before.

The role

You bring many years of audit experience and use it to expand our platform conceptually. You co-decide which audit problems we solve next, design how our platform addresses them, and grow the value dnl contributes to every engagement. This role is for auditors, not career product managers: audit experience is required, product management experience is not.

You know first-hand where audits lose time, where risks are missed and which workarounds teams rely on. You don't need to code. You need to think in structured processes and want to build the tools you always wished you had. You work closely with our engineering and AI team, our customers and the management team.

Tasks

  • Identify the biggest pain points across the audit process - from planning to reporting – and turn them into new product areas beyond the current setup
  • Develop concepts for how our platform expands its coverage and grows its contribution to each audit engagement
  • Co-decide our product roadmap with the management team and engineering: validate problems with audit firms, prioritise what we build next and specify the audit logic behind it - including what "correct" looks like
  • Translate accounting and auditing standards (IFRS, HGB, ISA, IDW PS) into clear, software-executable logic, decision trees and workflows
  • Design review and control mechanisms that keep the auditor in charge - transparency, traceability and professional skepticism instead of blind reliance on AI
  • Make sure our results fit cleanly into audit working papers and firm methodologies
  • Work hands-on with engineering and AI to test outputs, evaluate quality and ship improvements fast
  • Be the voice of the auditor in the company and represent dnl with customers, at industry events and in regulatory discussions

Requirements

Must haves

  • 6+ years in financial statement audit, ideally at a Big 4 or leading mid-market firm, up to (senior) audit manager level
  • A solid understanding of engagement responsibility and liability risk - you know what it takes to sign off
  • Strong command of IFRS and/or HGB as well as ISA and IDW PS, and the ability to turn standards into reproducible processes
  • Structured, analytical thinking: you can sketch a decision tree and define the right outcome for edge cases
  • The ability to explain complex topics simply to engineers, customers and decision-makers
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools
  • Motivation to reshape the profession, not just to take the next career step
  • Native or near-native English - German is a plus
  • You are Europe-based

Nice to have

  • Experience in product management, audit methodology or audit tooling/digitisation projects
  • WP/CPA/ACA qualification or working towards one

Benefits

  • Creative freedom: You will be given ownership from day one in a team with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths. You will have the opportunity to actively shape the development and scaling of the company.
  • First-class team: International and motivated team. Despite many different locations, regular (online) team events take place to celebrate our joint successes.
  • Development opportunities: You have the opportunity to start your career in a fast-growing company as well as in Enterprise SaaS Sales, quickly climbing the first steps on the career ladder.
  • Remote Work: We encourage flexibility by allowing you to work 100 % from home from anywhere within Europe.
  • Attractive conditions: 30 days' vacation, attractive salary package, a monthly voucher and regular online and offline team events.

Apply now and help shape the future of our company!
We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Doctors and Medical Experts required for AI research Projects (open/rolling applications)
description:
We are looking for doctors to join our growing community of experts who are available to be matched on an on-going basis to new innovative AI projects with the world's leading AI labs and companies that are bringing to life AI in healthcare.

Your medical expertise will shape the way AI understands and processes real-world clinical interactions, workflows, consultations including the delivery of care with software that directly impacts both healthcare professionals and patients.

These projects are flexible, fully remote and ideal for clinicians who want to work on shaping the future of AI in healthcare alongside their existing professional or academic commitments.

About Mentis AI

At Mentis AI, we’re building the next generation of AI systems grounded in real-world clinical expertise. As a clinical expert, you’ll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI model development, working side-by-side with senior AI researchers and clinicians to translate your medical knowledge into industry-ready clinical solutions to advance healthcare.

How it works

Once we have a new project, you will be automatically screened and matched to assess if you are a suitable fit. If shortlisted, we will then invite you to take a skills test (~10-30mins) and if required will also conduct an interview.

We are looking to match you based on your skillset, expertise, grade and speciality to make sure it's the right fit for the project!

If successful, you will be onboarded onto the platform and can start getting involved in a diverse range of tasks that vary from labelling clinical notes, summarising medical records, annotating images to reviewing and evaluating the performance of AI Models/LLMs.

The rapid rise of AI in healthcare means there are so many new and exciting ways to train, review and improve the deployment of AI in healthcare, which you will directly have an impact upon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data labeling and curation: Review clinical notes, audio, videos and other modalities, identifying relations and reasoning steps per guidelines.

  • LLM and model evaluations: Run structured evals (human-in-the-loop) to assess accuracy, safety, clinical relevance and clinical reasoning of models.

  • Prompting and prompt-engineering: Design, test, and iterate prompts to improve performance and reliability.

  • Fine-tuning support: Create high-quality instructions/responses and explore edge-case datasets to enhance models.

  • Feedback and error analysis: Identify critical/failure points, propose strategies to help mediate and document findings.

  • Scoring/Rubrics frameworks: Develop and refine scoring rubrics for quality assurance (e.g., accuracy, clarity, safety, completeness, guideline adherence).

  • Guideline refinement: Collaborate with researchers to improve annotation standards, acceptance criteria, and evaluation protocols.

Essential Requirements

  • Doctor based in the UK with an active GMC license.

  • Native or near-native fluency in English (spoken and written).

  • Good understanding of clinical terminology, tools and workflows.

  • Excellent summarisation and written communication skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to clinical accuracy.

  • Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote work

  • Asynchronous and flexible scheduling, allowing you to balance work with clinical practice or studies.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience.

  • The opportunity to influence and enhance AI tools that serve healthcare professionals.

  • Experience working at the intersection of medicine and AI, helping shape the future of healthcare.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with clinicians and AI researchers to deepen your own clinical acumen and professional expertise in AI within healthcare.

title: People Operations and AI Partner
description:

Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We're looking for someone who loves building automations, agents and workflows, and wants to point that instinct at People Ops. You'll own the data and systems behind our People Ops stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote), and use that ownership as the foundation for turning slow, manual, multi-tool processes into things that mostly run themselves. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automations, workflows, and AI agents across our People Ops tooling (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) - from a simple triggered workflow to a more sophisticated internal agent - turning multi-step manual processes into things that run themselves.

  • Own the data layer everything else depends on: keep HiBob/Ashby/Remote data clean, resolve integration and schema issues between systems, and treat data integrity as the foundation of what you build, not an afterthought.

  • Run new joiner onboarding end to end, but treat every manual step you touch twice as a candidate for automation, with the goal is to keep making the process faster and lighter-touch, not just execute it reliably.

  • Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc, that catch data errors before they become a downstream mess in payroll or compliance.

  • Process documentation: create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and playbooks for onboarding, offboarding, and systems admin current as processes evolve, so nothing lives only in your head.

  • Partner with relevant stakeholders on anything touching UK employment or compliance judgement calls while you build fluency here. You own the system and the escalation path, and that ownership shifts to you over time.

Your background:

  • You can genuinely build: hands-on with automation/workflow tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, Retool or similar), and you've actually built or configured AI agents.

  • You've worked with structured data and APIs enough to reason about schemas, integrations, and what breaks when two systems disagree with each other.

  • You're comfortable being the systems administrator of SaaS platforms: owning permissions, workflows, and integrations, ideally across an HRIS/ATS/EOR stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) or a comparable set of business systems.

  • You've worked in a high-growth environment, ideally remote and across multiple geographies, and you're comfortable working async across EMEA time zones.

  • Any exposure to People Ops, HR systems, or UK employment practices is a genuine bonus, not a

  • requirement - we're hiring for the builder instinct first, and will coach the domain knowledge.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You're an Owner. You don't wait to be told the onboarding flow needs fixing, you notice the friction and you just fix it.

  • You're Fast. You'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month designing the perfect one.

  • You like Simple. Your default build is the one with the fewest moving parts, not the most impressive one.

  • You find Surprising in the unglamorous stuff. You get a kick out of turning "someone does this by hand every month" into something nobody thinks about again.

  • You're Human, even with agents. You know the systems you're building sit behind someone's first week at a new job, or a colleague's benefits question — you design for that person, not just for the workflow diagram.

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Number and scope of manual People Ops processes automated, and time saved per cycle

  • HiBob / Ashby / Remote data accuracy rate

  • Time to resolve employee systems requests

  • Reduction in error rate flowing into compliance-relevant fields

Benefits:

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

title: AI Response Analyst

The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.
